Show notifications for saved clipboard entries, download progress, and Shizuku status. You can choose whether to allow them. Turning notifications off does not affect reading or saving clipboard content.

Clipboard history\nWhile open, ClipMaster reads and saves clipboard content so you can view your history. With Shizuku permission, it can also do this while you use other apps. Entries include copied text, time, and the source app when available. They may contain sensitive information such as passwords and verification codes.

Online previews\nWhen enabled, ClipMaster automatically visits websites and image servers for copied links to fetch titles, summaries, and cover images. These services may receive the link URL, including its parameters, and your IP address.

Notifications\nShow notifications for saved clipboard entries, download progress, and Shizuku status. You can choose whether to grant system notification permission. Turning notifications off does not affect reading or saving clipboard content.

Choose “Not now” to keep reading, saving, and managing entries while ClipMaster is open, without enabling background reading or online previews, or requesting notification permission.\nChoose “Agree and continue” to enable online previews and then set up Shizuku and notification permissions. You can change each option later in Me.

Automatically visit linked websites and image servers to fetch titles, summaries, and cover images. When off, you can still save clipboard content and view existing entries and locally cached previews.
